articles.headline: Prepare yourself for the ultimate day of sport -- mark your calendars
articles.description: Mark down July 19 into your calendars as a day you need to be in front of the TV watching a day of sport that will go down in history.

articles.headline: Why are there hydration breaks at the 2026 World Cup, and why has FIFA been criticised?
articles.description: All 104 matches at the 2026 World Cup are stopping for two hydration breaks. Why have they been stipulated by FIFA, and why have they been criticised?

articles.headline: Dan Burn defends England tactics but says Argentina goals felt like 'a matter of time'
articles.description: Dan Burn said he believed it was "our time" to win the World Cup but defended Thomas Tuchel's tactics as England's dream ended in semifinal heartbreak against Argentina.

articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel retains FA backing despite England's World Cup exit - sources
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel is set to stay on as England head coach to Euro 2028 after retaining the backing of the FA, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup match schedule: Fixtures, results, features

articles.headline: Argentina expose England's all-too-familiar World Cup faults
articles.description: The agony is perpetual, and the torment terminal. Once again, everything seemed to be going right for England in a tournament -- precisely up until the moment it didn't.
